data.body: Patchset 2 pushed to Gerrit change 2196. Root-caused the patchset-1 CI failure: _describe_class captured inherited builtin/typing method signatures (exception bases + typing.Protocol-injected __init__) which differ across Python 3.12/3.13 and platforms, causing non-portable surface drift. Fix: class descriptors now capture only methods whose defining class AND underlying function are rebar-owned (rebar/rebar.* __module__). Regenerated baseline; local lint/typecheck/complexity/14 gate tests green. Awaiting re-review + CI.
